scoring_justification: Checker recomputes ENSP = Se_eVnm / Sn_eVnm from the agent's raw stopping-power columns, then compares the recomputed ENSP to paper-reported gold values (Table 1) with tolerance ±0.02 and verifies monotonic ordering across the four compositions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported ENSP gold values for four fluorapatite compositions and their expected monotonic ordering
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (DOI: 10.1039/c3ra42246a): ENSP column — Pb4Ca6(VO4)6F2: 0.68, Ca10(VO4)6F2: 0.73, Ca10(P0.5V0.5O4)6F2: 0.76, Ca10(PO4)6F2: 0.79. Ordering from Section 3.1 and Table 1: Ca10PO4 > Ca10P0.5V0.5O4 > Ca10VO4 > Pb4Ca6VO4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published SRIM-computed ENSP values, directly stated in Table 1 with full precision.

schema.description: Four rows for Ca10VO4_6F2, Ca10P0.5V0.5O4_6F2, Ca10PO4_6F2, Pb4Ca6VO4_6F2 in that order.

outputs.description: Computed electronic stopping power (Se), nuclear stopping power (Sn), and their ratio (ENSP) for the four fluorapatite compositions under 1 MeV Kr²⁺ irradiation.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that ENSP values match the paper's reported gold within a tolerance and that the ordering Ca10PO4_6F2 > Ca10P0.5V0.5O4_6F2 > Ca10VO4_6F2 > Pb4Ca6VO4_6F2 is satisfied. The agent must write exactly four rows in the specified order.

steps.description: Recompute ENSP = Se_eVnm / Sn_eVnm from raw columns, compare to paper gold values within tolerance, verify ordering.
